title: UAAP: Redemption fueled NU win over La Salle, says Jumamoy

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Reinhard Jumamoy had plenty of motivation on Sunday when National University took on defending champion La Salle in the second round of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. Aside from wanting to avenge the Bulldogs’ first-round loss, Jumamoy recalled how the Green Archers broke their hearts last year in the Final Four. “I told my teammates that this is our redemption. La Salle eliminated us last year,” he said after NU’s 84-80 win. “That became such a motivation for me.
